schema.text: When you use public transport, how much does traffic noise bother or annoy you?
schema.help: Think about waiting at stops and travelling on board public transport.

en.#When you use public transport, how much: When you use public transport, how much does traffic noise bother or annoy you?
en.#Think about waiting at stops and travel: Think about waiting at stops and travelling on board public transport.

it.#When you use public transport, how much: Quando usi i mezzi pubblici, quanto ti disturba o ti infastidisce il rumore del traffico?
it.#Think about waiting at stops and travel: Pensa all’attesa alla fermata e al viaggio a bordo dei mezzi pubblici.

fr.#When you use public transport, how much: Lorsque vous utilisez les transports en commun, dans quelle mesure le bruit de la circulation vous dérange-t-il ?
fr.#Think about waiting at stops and travel: Pensez à l’attente aux arrêts et au trajet à bord des transports en commun.

de.#When you use public transport, how much: Wie sehr stört oder ärgert Sie Verkehrslärm bei Fahrten mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln?
de.#Think about waiting at stops and travel: Denken Sie an das Warten an Haltestellen und die Fahrt in öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln.

tr.#When you use public transport, how much: Toplu taşıma kullanırken trafik gürültüsü sizi ne kadar rahatsız eder veya sinirlendirir?
tr.#Think about waiting at stops and travel: Duraklarda beklemeyi ve toplu taşıma araçlarında yolculuk yapmayı düşünün.

fa.#When you use public transport, how much: هنگام استفاده از حمل‌ونقل عمومی، سروصدای ترافیک چقدر شما را اذیت یا آزرده می‌کند؟
fa.#Think about waiting at stops and travel: انتظار در ایستگاه‌ها و سفر با وسایل حمل‌ونقل عمومی را در نظر بگیرید.

hu.#When you use public transport, how much: Tömegközlekedés közben mennyire zavarja vagy bosszantja a forgalom zaja?
hu.#Think about waiting at stops and travel: Gondoljon a megállókban való várakozásra és a tömegközlekedési járműveken való utazásra.

ar.#When you use public transport, how much: عند استخدام وسائل النقل العام، ما مدى انزعاجك من ضجيج حركة المرور؟
ar.#Think about waiting at stops and travel: فكّر في الانتظار في المحطات والسفر على متن وسائل النقل العام.
